title: Cinta 336
style: Phonk-driven reggaeton trap with a dembow pulse and gritty swung drums; verse rides sparse sub, clipped handclaps, siren-like synth stabs, and a detuned bell motif, pre-chorus strips to filtered drums and gang chants, chorus hits with thicker bass, bright horn accents, and shouted bilingual hooks. Close-mic lead vocal with doubles on the hook, ad-lib throws on tag words, reversed swells into section changes, and a bright punchy mix with heavy low-end, rap, fake, bounce, rock, tone
lyrics:
[Intro]
Unit three three six
Math Driver online
Delta Alpha Plan engaged
Hyperspeed
¡Vamos ya!

[Verse 1]
Phonk bounce, my boys in line
Right lane switch, we take that shine
Blue sirens crawling in the rear
Chat in the radio, crystal clear
A robin slips through the mansion gate
Fake that break, then we accelerate
Stripe on the sleeve, no need to rage
We flip that script, we break the cage
¡Ja! bro, we move like smoke
You heard the sergeant, now we go
Sneak that drift, then cut that toy
Phonky steps with a savage joy

[Pre-Chorus]
Free birds sing it back
Hear that signal crack
Three three six, it rings
Now the whole block swings
Cash back drop, what a shock
Cage gets bent, then the clock stops

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Math Driver, delta alpha plan
Hyperspeed, we take the hand
You got this, we believe
Done safe, done sound, now breathe
Our robin, our robin
Our robin in the hood
¡No más jaula!
A robin in the hood

[Verse 2]
Sandbox City, sand in my eyes
Toys on the floor, fake alibis
Where did the good time go?
Same dull loop, same tired show
I forgot what eight is for
Still the words keep kicking the door
Palabras girando sin temor
Now the map says “run,” not “more”
VDS Mansion in the heat
Math Driver moving both my feet
No way back, we leave today
Thrash that toy and drift away
G4 glide with the pedal down
DJ Zyn Rose, we shake that town

[Pre-Chorus]
We got this, we got this
Doors start to split
Three three six in the air
Feel that pressure lift
Sandbox fading in the glass
Now the old chains don’t last

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Math Driver, delta alpha plan
Hyperspeed, we take the hand
You got this, we believe
Done safe, done sound, now breathe
Our robin, our robin
Our robin in the hood
¡No más jaula!
A robin in the hood

[Bridge]
Three mirrors, reflect the plan
Three mirrors, we move as one
Hyperspeed cutting through the wall
Sirens fade while the engines call
Three, three, six
¡Vamos pa’ la libertad!
Three, three, six
We don’t look back, we’re glad

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
(For good!)
¡Robin en el hood, pero pa’ bien!
Escaping hyperspeed
No más jaula again
Sandbox City in the mirror
VDS Mansion in the glow
VDS Mansion party for me
¡Fiesta en la mansión, vámonos!
Hyperspeed to sovereignty
We made it, can’t you see?
Our robin, our robin
Our robin in the hood
¡Sin jaula, sin miedo, pa’ siempre!
A robin in the hood

[Outro]
Math Driver laughing
Crowd on the rise
We made it out the sandbox
Under open skies
Three three six forever
VDS Mansion lit
¡Sin jaula, sin miedo, pa’ siempre!
